title: Main Propulsion Diesel Engine Spare Parts
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC JACKSONVILLE.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR JACKSONVILLE
detail_text: The Naval Supply (NAVSUP) Systems Command, Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Jacksonville, FL. intends to issue a sole source award utilizing Simplified Acquisitions Procedures to Fairbanks Morse Defense. The requirement is for the following Main Propulsion Diesel Engine spare parts aboard the USS Minneapolis St. Paul (LCS-21): Part Number / Nomenclature 00164121232 Lockwasher, M12 STD Series 13002412 Heater, Immersion, 5”-150# 40KW 13001684 Gasket 5.0” ANSI 14006278 Seal, Mechanical, Complete, Pump AS93 14001935 O-Ring Gasket 00164161232 Lockwasher, M16 STD Series 14001925 Gasket 14001928 O-Ring 14001935 O-Ring Gasket 14002098 O-Ring Gasket 00164121232 Lockwasher, M12 STD Series PA12654062 PA6B Fuel Injector Assembly (350 BAR) 00658080068-002 Gasket, PA6B Cylinder Head Cover, Viton The applicable North American Industrial Classification System Code (NAICS) code is 333618, with a size standard of 1,500. This notice of intent is for informational purposes only. This notice does not constitute a request for proposals, request for quote or an invitation to bid. All sources eligible to provide the requirement must respond in writing. Responses must be supported with clear and convincing evidence to clearly articulate the ability to provide the requirements as outlined above. A request for documentation will not be considered as an affirmative response. If no response is received to this notice, to the effect that comparable items are available, and that this is more advantageous to the Government than obtaining this product through a sole source contract, then a sole source acquisition award will be made.
